title: Palindrome check
prompt: Implement `boolean isPalindrome(String s)`: true when s reads the same forwards and backwards (case-sensitive; single chars and the empty string are palindromes). Compare s.charAt(i) with s.charAt(s.length() - 1 - i) — or reverse and equals.

tests.name: palindrome verdicts
tests.hint: Only need to check up to the middle; mismatch fails fast.
